notes.title: PON’S BREAKING RECORDS!
notes.content:
Hehe, yeah, you’ve seen the title.

Pon’s getting all the closer to world domination! [b]WE’RE ACTUALLY DOING IT[/b].

Thank you guys for helping us hit our first huge milestone. We are very appreciative of everyone's support! We're really glad that everyone is enjoying their small glimpses of Pon's world so far. We will be using this milestone excitement to work even harder on the development!.

Here’s a little thank you from Pon:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218539/2894c1ca770293e8d13c7f9bd002e33a074245f4.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]WATCH US DISCUSS THE ORIGINS OF TANUKI: PON’S SUMMER
[/h2]
Another awesome thing. Like, when it’s raining, it’s pouring, but somehow with great news??

We’ve got our hands on the dev diary that our friends at [i]ASUS ROG[/i] filmed and put together for us.

The dev diary in question was shot during this summer in Kyoto:
[previewyoutube=i9UdDfeEoXI;full][/previewyoutube]

By the way, this interview was partly shot at [i]BRIDGE[/i], our favourite bar and sort of an alma mater of [i]Denkiworks Studio[/i], where our ideas had grown from talks to action points and then to actually founding our own company. If you've played the demo... you may actually recognize the interior? 👀

Thank you so much, [i]ASUS ROG[/i], for believing in us and taking us under your wing aka ROG Dev Accelerator program! 

[hr][/hr]
[h2]PON DEMANDS MORE TRICKS.
[/h2]
Seeing the wishlist counter growing is such a nice sight, we want to make sure that more players get a chance to participate in our very first contest!

So, we’re extending the deadline for tricks contest submissions.

Let us get through the [b]requirements[/b], just in case:

[list]
[*] Submit a combo chain of tricks. It’s gotta be clean, or long, or crazy, or all of the things combined! Make your skills and imagination run wild.
[*] Post your clip on X with the hashtag [b]#tanukiponssummer[/b]
[*] This is not a contest of popularity. The combo judges from [b]Denkiworks[/b] and [b]CRITICAL REFLEX[/b] will rule out their decision solely based on what we deem worthy of the prizes. 
[/list]
[h3]SUBMISSION DEADLINE
[/h3]Submit before [b]21/08/2025, 8 pm PST[/b]. Yep, ten more days to hone your BMXing.

[h3]PRIZES[/h3]
[list]
[*] A digital copy of the full game at launch. At least the delivery won’t be postponed by some sudden side hustles of the delivery guy.
[*] A commemorative shrine decoration. Nothing like a whole world being reminded of your coolness till the end of time, right?
[/list]
There are only three Champions-to-be. Can you become one of them? Only Tanuki gods can tell [spoiler]but they won’t[/spoiler].

[h3]ONE OF OUR FAV SUBMISSIONS SO FAR:
[/h3][img]https://i.postimg.cc/90wbZJ8x/gifsubhighlight-ezgif-com-optimize.gif[/img]

Feeling intimidated? Fight that.

[hr][/hr]
This is never gonna be not exciting to repeat:

Thank you. Thank you! THANK YOU!

Follow @denkiworks on X, and join the CRITICAL REFLEX server on Discord to get all the Tanuki updates first! 

[i]We’re not done yet,
DenkiWorks and CRITICAL REFLEX[/i]

notes.title: The Tanuki’s Journey: From Cycling to Something Bigger
notes.content:
Hey, guys!
Welcome to our first devlog! It’s been quite a while since the last announcement, and we’re excited to share how our game is coming together. First things first:  let's start at the very beginning.

[h3]…the Idea.[/h3]
Denkiworks was founded by the three of us: Liam, Arioka, and Jan. We had worked together before and wanted to create something as a team again. The idea started with a simple thought: what if we made a game about cycling through Kyoto? Liam, who biked around the city all the time, wanted to capture that feeling of freedom and movement. 

At first, it was just about the joy of riding through a city. But we quickly realized we needed a reason for the player to keep cycling — and that’s where deliveries came in. What if Pon wasn’t just aimlessly biking around but actually had a goal? That goal became saving money to restore a shrine, which led to the idea of a Matsuri festival and became an important part of the story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218539/ab47e4c19309d5f6a1d93f44959f1091a3468eb6.jpg[/img][i]Matsuri concept art[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KlbMPfa.gif[/img][i]The festival celebration in the game’s intro animation[/i]

[h3]Why a Tanuki?[/h3]
When designing [i]the main character[/i], we wanted something different from the usual dogs and cats. A fox was an option, though not the best fit to be the main, since foxes are already everywhere in the Japanese media. Someone to stand out… Tanuki, on the other hand? They’re funny, mischievous, and deeply tied to Japanese folklore. Thus, it was decided, tanuki it is!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218539/13ad8c4a2a51e270a5ae8a7353dac94d2ab275c3.png[/img][i]Tanuki sketches[/i]

Naming him was easy since "Pon" is linked to the sound of a tanuki belly-slapping in Japanese. The design came together quickly after that. Pon is a bit of a goof—he grew up at the shrine but didn’t really care about it until he had to. The moment we saw his tiny legs, little paws, and oversized bag, we knew we had something special. His strong silhouette and slightly silly face made us fall in love with him right away.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218539/f5035bf20c5423c3d98c70fd8fceb1b443497656.jpg[/img][i]Pon’s concept art[/i]

(Yes, we DID think about his… uh, [i]traditional tanuki traits[/i]. But, well… Some things better be left out to keep the main concept of the game.)
By the way, we still included a fox character, playing into the classic fox-versus-tanuki folklore rivalry. But while the game has mythological nods, it’s not a magical world. Pon’s "sick tricks" might feel like magic, but there's no actual shapeshifting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218539/fcdd28a809bb47337a143d52dda8de8d46c65e33.jpg[/img][i]The fox in question[/i]

[h3]What’s next?[/h3]
At its core, Pon is all about movement and fun, and that focus has shaped the design of the town, as well as the characters you meet, the quest lines, and the exciting activities you'll dive into. We’ll share more on that in future devlogs.
Before we sign off, we’ve got some exciting news — Tanuki Pon’s Summer is officially joining Xbox Game Pass! Check out the cool trailer here:

[previewyoutube=rBu9470rXD8;full][previewyoutube=rBu9470rXD8;leftthumb]LINK[/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

Almost forgot: follow us on X and join Critical Reflex Discord to stay in the loop and share your thoughts!

[i]Now, back to work… there’s still a shrine to fix! See you in the next one.
DenkiWorks and Critical Reflex[/i]

notes.title: TANUKI: Pon's Summer coming soon to Steam
notes.content:
Hey, we’re Denkiworks! We’re excited to announce that our new project TANUKI: Pon’s Summer, is coming to Steam!

Check out the trailer!

[previewyoutube=yHqHWN7vIAs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]So, what [i]is [/i]TANUKI: Pon’s Summer?[/h3]

Basically, it’s a chill tanuki-deliveryman-decorator simulator with a twist! Or should we say BMX tricks?
You’ll step into the paws of Pon, a lazy yet talented and mischievous tanuki. The Great Tanuki deity tasks you with restoring the Great Tanuki shrine before summer’s end, just in time for the Matsuri festival. Surely, to get it done, you’ll need plenty of cash! So, say goodbye to your lazy days and gear up for a summer packed with adventure.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ISXIDVv.gif[/img]


FEATURES:
[list][*] Ride in style! Show off your mad skills, perform epic BMX tricks, grinds, flips, and stunts as you cruise around town;
[*] Master the art of delivery as the best part-time delivery-tanuki in all four towns. Well, it’s not like you’ll have a competition. Still, give it your all;
[*] Engage in various summer activities like bug catching, karaoke, fishing, baseball, and more;
[*] Befriend the locals and fill out their postcards;
[*] Decorate the heaven out of the shrine to make it as beautiful as possible;
[*] Explore a scenic town, inspired by real Japanese cities: Kyoto, Aomori, Sapporo, and Beppu.[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jTZC4DT.gif[/img]

May the summer begin,
DenkiWorks and Critical Reflex
